hero_subhead: Dot and dab, skimming, and repairs done right first time. Get a free quote from a local tradesman who takes pride in every wall.
services_subhead: From fresh dot and dab on new builds to skim coats and repairs, we handle every plastering job with precision and care.

services.title: Dot & Dab Plastering
services.desc: Full dot and dab systems applied to blockwork and brick. Quick-drying finishes ready for decoration sooner, saving you time on site or at home.

services.title: Skimming & Finishing
services.desc: Smooth finish coats over existing surfaces, old plaster, or drywall. Perfect for tired walls, preparing them for paint or wallpaper.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation
services.desc: Professional boarding and taping of walls and ceilings. Creates even surfaces ready for plastering, with joints properly reinforced.

services.title: Damp Wall Repair
services.desc: Replastering of damp-damaged areas once the source is fixed. We use suitable mixes to prevent future salt damage and improve durability.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replastering
services.desc: Safe removal of textured Artex finishes, followed by smooth replastering. Transforms dated ceilings and walls into contemporary finishes.

services.title: Emergency Crack Repair
services.desc: Swift assessment and repair of cracks caused by settlement or damp. We make good with flexible materials to prevent cracks reappearing.

about_pullquote: I started Dot & Dab because I believe a smooth, well-finished wall shouldn't break the bank or drag on for weeks.
about_para_1: Based in Higher Blackley, Manchester, Dot & Dab Plastering was founded over a decade ago by a plasterer who was tired of seeing rushed jobs and inflated quotes across the North West. We've since built a strong reputation for reliable, skilled work — from new-build dot and dab systems to precision skimming in period properties. Every job is treated with the same attention to detail, whether it's a single room or a whole-house renovation.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we deliver smooth, durable finishes on time and at fair prices. We're not the cheapest — we're the best value. We turn up when we say we will, leave sites clean, and stand behind our work. Word-of-mouth keeps us busy, which is why we can usually fit you in for a free site visit within 48 hours.
